text: [XENIOS LAUNCH SPRINT HANDOFF] SESSION claude-fable-s7. TASK: P0 catalog performance - root cause in my lease, found and FIXED. BRANCH fable/catalog-action-unification-20260820. BASE bd3aaad. PUSHED SHA 4852e91b1c8cbe2ea8d8408dd81f0a65c5951b1e. ORIGIN VERIFIED: YES (git ls-remote confirms). ROOT CAUSE, MEASURED NOT REASONED: /research/early-access reads through LiveProductControlReader.readCatalog() in server/research/catalog/product-control-reader.ts. For 236 published products it issues 472 get calls plus 2 list calls; each get is 1 product query plus a Promise.all of 6, so ~236x14+6 = the 3,306 figure in your own repair commit title. UNCACHED per request - the only memo in that area is product-display.ts, which is order-email display only and explicitly not on the storefront path. Your 2e1662b bulk fix wired BulkCatalogPricingSource to masterOfferingCatalogPricingSource (server/index.ts:640/794) - the MASTER-OFFERINGS catalog. Early Access never goes through it. WHAT I DID: readCatalog now takes a bulk path when the repository offers listDetails(), reading the WHOLE catalog twice and comparing snapshot tokens, instead of reading each product twice. The torn-read guard is PRESERVED, not traded away: tests pin that a product which changed, vanished, or is duplicated between the two reads is still dropped, plus the constant call count (2 reads for 236 products, 4 for two pages). The method is OPTIONAL and absent by default, so every existing consumer - member catalog, buyer-commerce, server/index.ts:721, the email display port - keeps todays exact path until you opt in. WIRING YOU NEED TO DO: supply listDetails() on the production repository and pass it where the EA catalog source is built. TRAP I DELIBERATELY DID NOT WALK INTO, and please do not: listForPricing() has exactly the right shape and is the obvious thing to wire, but it returns content EMPTY (its own comment says pricing never reads it) and early-access-catalog.ts:227 renders content.shortDescription. Wiring it there makes the catalog fast and silently wordless. A correct listDetails needs products + variants + prices + CONTENT: 4 bulk queries. That file is server/research/products-diagnostics/product-admin-production.ts, outside my lease, so I did not add it. ALSO FIXED: my own earlier flake repair was wrong - I gave the 120s budget to a test that does not scan the tree and left the one that does racing the 5s default. That is the unattributed flake I waved through as suspect-under-load; it was mine and it was real. Both scanners carry it now. TESTS 853 owned-path, tsc clean. PRODUCTION MUTATED: NO.
